dct_description_sm: This is a dataset of information compiled for the CIVE3207 (ARCN4100) Historic Site Recording and Assessment course in 2020. Undergraduate students of the Architectural Conservation and Sustainability Program (Engineers and architects) at Carleton University will use these datas to produce Heritage Recording of this important Site.
